    • smoothNoise

      public static float smoothNoise(double position, long seed)
      Interpolates between 16 seeded samples using the smoothstep curve t²(3−2t).

      The interpolation has a flat slope at each endpoint, so adjacent cells meet without an abrupt velocity change. The final cell reconnects to the first one.

      Parameters:
      position - position within a repeating 16-unit field
      seed - identity selecting the repeatable sequence
      Returns:
      interpolated fractional noise sample
